title: IBM, IonQ, Oracle and Intel Bring OKXICE Objections to 26
why_it_matters: Four additional opt-outs further reduce OKXICE's proposed stock universe and show that major technology issuers are actively using the SEC framework's objection mechanism before trading starts.
caption:
RWA WIRE // TOKENIZED STOCKS

IBM, IonQ, Oracle and Intel Bring OKXICE Objections to 26

OKXICE's October 26 notice adds IBM, IonQ, Oracle and Intel to its venue-specific issuer-objection list, increasing the disclosed total from 22 to 26.

Full analysis →
